items.text: Eagles will play first game without Jalen Hurts (calf/blood clot); Tanner McKee starts. Confirmed OUT alongside Barkley.
items.why: Blood clot in calf; already ruled earlier in week.
items.implication: McKee has top pass-catchers healthy (Smith back); limited rushing upside vs Hurts.
items.opportunity: Elevated volume for DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks in pass-heavy script possibly.

items.text: Sunday FantasyFootball injuries roundup: OUT Lamar Jackson, Saquon Barkley/Jalen Hurts/Will Shipley, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, Breece Hall, David Montgomery, Baker Mayfield. QUESTIONABLE AJ Brown/TreVeyon Henderson, Caleb Williams, Tyler Warren, Chris Olave/Alvin Kamara, etc. IN Ladd McConkey/Quentin Johnston, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix, Marvin Harrison Jr.
items.implication: Multiple high-value status locks and clearances for lineup decisions.
items.opportunity: Clear IN for McConkey/Smith/Lamb/Jeanty/Penix; OUT creates handcuff/backup spikes.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s game against the Panthers due to hamstring. Will Shipley also placed on IR.
items.why: Missed all week of practice with hamstring; official Friday ruling.
items.implication: Dameon Pierce expected to lead backfield; Eagles offense further depleted with Hurts also out.
items.opportunity: Increased carries and goal-line work for remaining Eagles RBs; pass-catchers like DeVonta Smith elevated with McKee starting.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday vs Rams; resting for long-term healing.
items.implication: ARI RB committee shifts; monitor backups for volume.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for remaining Cardinals backs.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury. Second straight week out.
items.why: Has not practiced; decision for long-term interest per coach.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts again; downgrade for Ravens pass catchers especially Andrews.
items.opportunity: Huntley game script may still support Flowers as WR2; monitor Ja'Kobi Lane return.

items.text: On ETR report: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday addition Q. Many Qs more like probable: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. PIT thin at WR expecting 2-WR with Metcalf. PHI McKee has top-4 pass catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks) but 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce.
items.why: Practice trends and designations; high ankle doubt for Henderson given practice.
items.implication: Lean start on probable-leaning Qs; fade thin PIT WR corps beyond Metcalf; Smith viable with McKee.
items.opportunity: Route/target share stable for cleared skill players; Warren groin monitor for Colts TE usage.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed IN (cleared from hamstring/toe); returns with McKee starting and Barkley/Hurts out.
items.why: Removed from report; full participant Friday.
items.implication: Borderline WR2 with McKee; top pass catcher healthy.
items.opportunity: High route share in depleted Eagles offense.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs removed from commissioner exempt list Monday; eligible to practice/play Week 7. Investigation ongoing.
items.why: NFL decision; probe continues but playable next week.
items.opportunity: Full RB role likely upon return.

items.text: AJ Brown is questionable (Patriots injury report).
items.implication: Monitor; if active major WR upgrade for NE.
items.opportunity: Target share spike if plays; Henderson also Q high-ankle.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday’s game (cleared).
items.implication: Full role expected vs KC; strong WR play.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets locked in; Quentin Johnston also IN.

items.text: After another full practice, Bears QB Caleb Williams officially questionable.
items.implication: Expected to play per Levitan probable lean; big upgrade if active vs ATL.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes if cleared; Bears pass game unlock.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers.
items.opportunity: High target upside vs weak pass D.

items.text: LOVE Drake London vs CHI as WR6; bankable usage.
LOVE Kyren Williams vs ARI as RB5; elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
